name: worker-shared-cache
description: A byte-bounded cache per name, shared by every Node worker thread in the process
author: Dave Tonge

scripts.build: napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir lib --js binding.js --dts binding.d.ts --release && tsc
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir lib --js binding.js --dts binding.d.ts && tsc
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --release -- -D warnings && tsc --noEmit
scripts.version: napi version --npm-dir npm && git add npm
